name: Building RAG Systems
description: Build a retrieval-augmented generation application using openly licensed documents. Prepare and index content, retrieve relevant passages, supply evidence to a language model and evaluate retrieval and answers.
external: Basic Python, package environments and familiarity with text data; introductory vector and similarity concepts are helpful.
learn: Chunk and index a small document collection
Retrieve relevant passages and generate grounded answers
Evaluate retrieval and answer quality against references
moduleDescriptions: Prepare a small openly licensed document corpus and split it into chunks.
Generate embeddings and build a searchable local index.
Retrieve relevant passages and generate answers with source references.
Measure retrieval quality and inspect grounded answers against test questions.
prerequisiteRationale: A01 supplies the model interface; retrieval and embeddings are taught within A05.
